title: Terminal kinds: only Claude and plain shell terminals are offered; Gemini, Codex and OpenCode are removed
summary: New terminals can only be Claude Code or a plain shell; Gemini, Codex and OpenCode and their config writers are removed, and old settings naming them still load.
